attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Immediate mouseover Earth Shock
macros.desc: Cancel your current cast to shock an enemy under your cursor while keeping your main target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Earth Shock
/stopcasting
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Earth Shock
macros.needs: Cancels your current cast
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Terreno
/stopcasting
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Choque Terreno

macros.title: Place, move or recall your totems
macros.desc: Press for your saved totem set. Hold Ctrl to bring your totems to where you stand, or Shift to recall them. Set up the totem bar first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Totemic Call; [mod:shift] Totemic Recall; Call of the Elements
/cast [mod:ctrl] Totemic Call; [mod:shift] Totemic Recall; Call of the Elements

keys.text: Call of the Elements: place the totems on your Totem Bar
Totemic Recall: pick your totems up and restore Mana
Totemic Call: move your totems to you

macros.needs: Call of the Elements and Totemic Recall learned; Totemic Call (level 22) for Ctrl
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Chamado Totêmico; [mod:shift] Revocação Totêmica; Chamado dos Elementos
/cast [mod:ctrl] Chamado Totêmico; [mod:shift] Revocação Totêmica; Chamado dos Elementos

macros.title: All three totem sets and recall on one key
macros.desc: Once you have the later Call spells, one key drops any of your three totem sets or takes them all back.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Call of the Ancestors; [mod:alt] Call of the Spirits; [mod:shift] Totemic Recall; Call of the Elements
/cast [mod:ctrl] Call of the Ancestors; [mod:alt] Call of the Spirits; [mod:shift] Totemic Recall; Call of the Elements
macros.needs: Call of the Elements (20), Call of the Ancestors (30) and Call of the Spirits (40). Each Call spell can place different totems, so set all three up first. Blizzard's 7 October article swaps those two levels; the game client has them as shown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:ctrl] Chamado dos Antepassados; [mod:alt] Chamado dos Espíritos; [mod:shift] Revocação Totêmica; Chamado dos Elementos
/cast [mod:ctrl] Chamado dos Antepassados; [mod:alt] Chamado dos Espíritos; [mod:shift] Revocação Totêmica; Chamado dos Elementos

macros.title: Lightning Shield or Water Shield
macros.desc: Press for Lightning Shield and hold Shift for Water Shield. Only one Elemental Shield stays on you at a time.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Water Shield; Lightning Shield
/cast [mod:shift] Water Shield; Lightning Shield
macros.needs: Water Shield talent for the Shift half
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Escudo de Água; Escudo de Raios
/cast [mod:shift] Escudo de Água; Escudo de Raios

macros.title: Ghost Wolf on and off
macros.desc: One press turns you into a Ghost Wolf and the next press turns you back.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Ghost Wolf
/cast Ghost Wolf
macros.needs: Ghost Wolf works outdoors only until you take Improved Ghost Wolf, which also allows indoors
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Lobo Fantasma
/cast Lobo Fantasma

macros.title: Mouseover Purge
macros.desc: Strip magic buffs from the enemy under your cursor, or from your target if you aren't pointing at anyone.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Purge
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Purge
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Expurgar
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Expurgar

macros.title: Earth, Flame and Frost Shock on one key
macros.desc: Press for Earth Shock, hold Shift for Flame Shock and Ctrl for Frost Shock.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Flame Shock; [mod:ctrl] Frost Shock; Earth Shock
/cast [mod:shift] Flame Shock; [mod:ctrl] Frost Shock; Earth Shock
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Choque Flamejante; [mod:ctrl] Choque Gélido; Choque Terreno
/cast [mod:shift] Choque Flamejante; [mod:ctrl] Choque Gélido; Choque Terreno

macros.title: Cure poison or disease on a friend or yourself
macros.desc: Cure Poison on your mouseover, your target or you, and hold Shift for Cure Disease on the same picks.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cure Disease; Cure Poison
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Cure Disease; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cure Poison

keys.text: Cure Poison on mouseover, target or yourself
Cure Disease on mouseover, target or yourself

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Curar Doença; Curar Veneno
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Curar Doença; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Curar Veneno

macros.title: Reincarnation cooldown on your bar
macros.desc: This puts Reincarnation's cooldown on a button so you can see whether you would come back after a death.
macros.code: #showtooltip Reincarnation
macros.needs: Reincarnation learned
macros.codePt: #showtooltip Reencarnação

macros.title: Heal yourself without losing your target
macros.desc: Healing Wave on yourself while your enemy stays targeted, or hold Shift for the faster Lesser Healing Wave.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Lesser Healing Wave; Healing Wave
/cast [mod:shift,@player] Lesser Healing Wave; [@player] Healing Wave
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Onda Curativa Menor; Onda Curativa
/cast [mod:shift,@player] Onda Curativa Menor; [@player] Onda Curativa

macros.title: Water Walking, Shift for Water Breathing
macros.desc: Water Walking on a friendly mouseover, target or yourself; hold Shift for Water Breathing. Handy for crossing water and underwater quests.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Water Breathing; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Water Walking
macros.needs: Both spells learned; Fish Oil for Water Walking and Shiny Fish Scales for Water Breathing
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Respiração Aquática; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Andar sobre a Água

macros.title: Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning
macros.desc: Hold Shift for Chain Lightning; press normally for Lightning Bolt.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Chain Lightning; Lightning Bolt
/cast [mod:shift] Chain Lightning; Lightning Bolt
macros.needs: Chain Lightning learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cadeia de Raios; Raio
/cast [mod:shift] Cadeia de Raios; Raio

macros.title: Mouseover Flame Shock
macros.desc: Apply the damage-over-time shock without changing your main target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flame Shock
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Flame Shock
macros.needs: Flame Shock learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Flamejante
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Choque Flamejante

macros.title: Lightning Mastery, then Bolt or Chain Lightning
macros.desc: Pops Lightning Mastery and casts Lightning Bolt, which casts 0.5 sec faster for 15 sec. Hold Shift for Chain Lightning, which has no cooldown while Mastery lasts.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Chain Lightning; Lightning Bolt
/cast Lightning Mastery
/cast [mod:shift] Chain Lightning; Lightning Bolt
macros.needs: Lightning Mastery talent; Chain Lightning (32) for Shift. Blizzard renamed it from Elemental Mastery on 2 November, so use the old name if your spellbook still has it. If Mastery is on cooldown the cast still starts.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Cadeia de Raios; Raio
/cast Maestria em Raio
/cast [mod:shift] Cadeia de Raios; Raio

macros.title: Fire Nova with a Fire totem on the same key
macros.desc: Fire Nova hits enemies within 10 yards of your active Fire totem, so Shift drops Searing Totem and Ctrl drops Magma Totem first.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Fire Nova
/cast [mod:shift] Searing Totem; [mod:ctrl] Magma Totem; Fire Nova
macros.needs: An active Fire totem for Fire Nova. Magma Totem is learned at 26.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Nova de Fogo
/cast [mod:shift] Totem Calcinante; [mod:ctrl] Totem de Magma; Nova de Fogo

macros.title: Searing Totem, Flame Shock, Lightning Bolt opener
macros.desc: Three presses open a pull: Searing Totem, then Flame Shock, then Lightning Bolt. Use your normal bolt key after that.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=combat/20 Searing Totem, Flame Shock, Lightning Bolt
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=combat/20 Totem Calcinante, Choque Flamejante, Raio

macros.title: Stoneclaw Totem or Earthbind Totem
macros.desc: Stoneclaw Totem pulls attackers within 8 yards onto itself for 15 seconds, and Shift drops Earthbind Totem to slow them instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Stoneclaw Totem
/cast [mod:shift] Earthbind Totem; Stoneclaw Totem
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Totem da Garra de Pedra
/cast [mod:shift] Totem de Prisão Terrena; Totem da Garra de Pedra

macros.title: Trinkets, racial and Lightning Bolt
macros.desc: Use both trinkets and your Orc or Troll racial as you start a Lightning Bolt.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lightning Bolt
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Berserking
/cast Blood Fury
/cast Lightning Bolt
macros.needs: Blood Fury (Orc) or Berserking (Troll). Forever changed both from Classic, and the line for the other race just fails.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raio
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Berserk
/cast Fúria Sangrenta
/cast Raio

macros.title: Lightning Bolt at what your tank is hitting
macros.desc: Bolts your enemy target, or the target of your friendly target when you have the tank selected.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lightning Bolt
/cast [harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead] Lightning Bolt
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raio
/cast [harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead] Raio

macros.title: Choose your weapon imbue
macros.desc: Press for Windfury Weapon, or hold Shift for Flametongue, Ctrl for Frostbrand or Alt for Rockbiter. The /use 16 line clicks your main hand.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:alt] Rockbiter Weapon; [mod:ctrl] Frostbrand Weapon; [mod:shift] Flametongue Weapon; Windfury Weapon
/cast [mod:alt] Rockbiter Weapon; [mod:ctrl] Frostbrand Weapon; [mod:shift] Flametongue Weapon; Windfury Weapon
/use 16
macros.needs: Windfury Weapon learned at 30. We haven't seen how Forever picks the weapon, so delete /use 16 if the imbue lands without it.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:alt] Arma Trinca-pedra; [mod:ctrl] Arma da Marca Gélida; [mod:shift] Arma de Labaredas; Arma de Fúria dos Ventos
/cast [mod:alt] Arma Trinca-pedra; [mod:ctrl] Arma da Marca Gélida; [mod:shift] Arma de Labaredas; Arma de Fúria dos Ventos
/use 16

macros.title: Stormstrike and auto attack
macros.desc: Begin swinging when you use your Enhancement strike.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Stormstrike
/startattack
/cast Stormstrike
macros.needs: Stormstrike talent. It's a 16-point talent, so you can take it at 25 (Blizzard, 7 October).
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ataque da Tempestade
/startattack
/cast Ataque da Tempestade

macros.title: Stormstrike, then Earth Shock
macros.desc: Stormstrike first, then Earth Shock on the next press. The next eligible spell gets 20% more damage within 12 seconds.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/startattack
/castsequence reset=combat/target/12 Stormstrike, Earth Shock
macros.needs: Stormstrike talent. It's a 16-point talent, so you can take it at 25 (Blizzard, 7 October).
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/startattack
/castsequence reset=combat/target/12 Ataque da Tempestade, Choque Terreno

macros.title: Spend Stormstrike on a shock or a bolt
macros.desc: After Stormstrike, press for Earth Shock, Shift for Lightning Bolt or Ctrl for Chain Lightning. The next of these gets 20% more damage within 12 seconds.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Lightning Bolt; [mod:ctrl] Chain Lightning; Earth Shock
/cast [mod:shift] Lightning Bolt; [mod:ctrl] Chain Lightning; Earth Shock
macros.needs: Stormstrike talent. It's a 16-point talent, so you can take it at 25 (Blizzard, 7 October). Chain Lightning is learned at 32.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Raio; [mod:ctrl] Cadeia de Raios; Choque Terreno
/cast [mod:shift] Raio; [mod:ctrl] Cadeia de Raios; Choque Terreno

macros.title: Lightning Bolt and keep swinging
macros.desc: Starts your melee swings and casts Lightning Bolt, so Maelstrom Weapon stacks from your hits shorten the cast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lightning Bolt
/startattack
/cast Lightning Bolt
macros.needs: Maelstrom Weapon talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raio
/startattack
/cast Raio

macros.title: Trinkets, Rage of the Farseer and Stormstrike
macros.desc: Use both trinkets, Rage of the Farseer and your Orc or Troll racial together, then open with Stormstrike.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Rage of the Farseer
/startattack
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Rage of the Farseer
/cast Berserking
/cast Blood Fury
/cast Stormstrike
macros.needs: Rage of the Farseer and Stormstrike talents. Blood Fury is for Orcs and Berserking for Trolls, and the other line just fails.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fúria do Clarividente
/startattack
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Fúria do Clarividente
/cast Berserk
/cast Fúria Sangrenta
/cast Ataque da Tempestade

macros.title: Flame Shock, then Earth Shock
macros.desc: Flame Shock on the first press, Earth Shock on the next, and your swings start with the first press.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/startattack [harm]
/castsequence reset=combat/target/12 Flame Shock, Earth Shock
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/startattack [harm]
/castsequence reset=combat/target/12 Choque Flamejante, Choque Terreno

macros.title: Strength of Earth, Windfury and Mana Spring in order
macros.desc: One totem per press, and the order starts again after 60 seconds or when combat ends.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=combat/60 Strength of Earth Totem, Windfury Totem, Mana Spring Totem
macros.needs: Windfury Weapon on your main hand turns off your own Windfury Totem bonus, so swap the totem if you use both
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence reset=combat/60 Totem da Força da Terra, Totem de Fúria dos Ventos, Totem Fonte de Mana

macros.title: Stoneskin, Windwall or Stoneclaw Totem
macros.desc: Stoneskin Totem cuts Physical damage taken, Shift drops Windwall Totem against ranged attackers and Ctrl drops Stoneclaw Totem to pull enemies onto it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Stoneskin Totem
/cast [mod:shift] Windwall Totem; [mod:ctrl] Stoneclaw Totem; Stoneskin Totem
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Totem Litopele
/cast [mod:shift] Totem da Barreira de Vento; [mod:ctrl] Totem da Garra de Pedra; Totem Litopele

macros.title: Find a target, attack and Earth Shock
macros.desc: Keep a living enemy selected, or select a nearby enemy when you have no hostile target. Start swinging even if Earth Shock is on cooldown or you lack mana.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Earth Shock
/targetenemy [noharm][dead]
/startattack
/cast Earth Shock
macros.needs: Earth Shock learned; this can select and pull a new enemy
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Terreno
/targetenemy [noharm][dead]
/startattack
/cast Choque Terreno

macros.title: Mouseover Healing Wave
macros.desc: Heal a friendly mouseover, your target, or yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Healing Wave
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Healing Wave
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Onda Curativa
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Onda Curativa

macros.title: Mouseover Riptide
macros.desc: Use Forever’s new Restoration talent on a party frame under your cursor.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Riptide
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Riptide
macros.needs: Riptide talent. Since 2 November it only heals over time, on a 12 sec cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Contracorrente
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Contracorrente

macros.title: Lesser Healing Wave on mouseover, target or target's target
macros.desc: The fast heal for the friend under your cursor, your friendly target, whoever your enemy target is hitting, or you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lesser Healing Wave
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead][@player] Lesser Healing Wave
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Onda Curativa Menor
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead][@player] Onda Curativa Menor

macros.title: Mouseover Chain Heal
macros.desc: Chain Heal on your mouseover, your target or yourself. In a party it only jumps to other party members.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Chain Heal
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Chain Heal
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cura Encadeada
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cura Encadeada

macros.title: Riptide, then Chain Heal on the same friend
macros.desc: Riptide on the first press and Chain Heal on the next, which lands 25% stronger on a Riptide target, so keep your cursor on the same friend.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] reset=10 Riptide, Chain Heal
macros.needs: Riptide talent
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] reset=10 Contracorrente, Cura Encadeada

macros.title: Top up with a lower Healing Wave rank
macros.desc: Press for your top Healing Wave rank, or hold Shift for the cheaper rank 4 when a small top-up is enough.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Healing Wave
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Healing Wave(Rank 4); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Healing Wave

keys.text: Top-rank Healing Wave on mouseover, target or yourself
Healing Wave rank 4 on the same picks

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Onda Curativa
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Onda Curativa(Grau 4); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Onda Curativa

macros.title: Nature's Swiftness into an instant heal
macros.desc: Nature's Swiftness makes your next heal instant, so this casts Healing Wave, or Chain Heal with Shift, on your mouseover, target or you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Healing Wave
/cast Nature's Swiftness
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Chain Heal; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Healing Wave
macros.needs: Nature's Swiftness talent. If it's on cooldown you start a normal cast.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Onda Curativa
/cast Rapidez da Natureza
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Cura Encadeada; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Onda Curativa

macros.title: Healing Stream, Mana Spring or Mana Tide Totem
macros.desc: Healing Stream Totem heals the group, Shift drops Mana Spring Totem and Ctrl drops Mana Tide Totem when mana runs low.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Healing Stream Totem
/cast [mod:shift] Mana Spring Totem; [mod:ctrl] Mana Tide Totem; Healing Stream Totem
macros.needs: Mana Tide Totem talent for Ctrl, and its Water Totem tool. It's a 16-point talent, so you can take it at 25 (Blizzard, 7 October).
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Totem de Torrente Curativa
/cast [mod:shift] Totem Fonte de Mana; [mod:ctrl] Totem de Vagalhão de Mana; Totem de Torrente Curativa

macros.title: Poison Cleansing, Disease Cleansing or Tremor Totem
macros.desc: Poison Cleansing Totem, or Shift for Disease Cleansing Totem and Ctrl for Tremor Totem, which removes Fear, Charm and Sleep.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Poison Cleansing Totem
/cast [mod:shift] Disease Cleansing Totem; [mod:ctrl] Tremor Totem; Poison Cleansing Totem
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Totem Antiveneno
/cast [mod:shift] Totem de Purificação de Doença; [mod:ctrl] Totem Sísmico; Totem Antiveneno

macros.title: Healing Wave on friends, Lightning Bolt on enemies
macros.desc: Heals a friendly target, bolts an enemy, heals you if nothing is selected, and Alt heals you whatever you have targeted.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:alt,@player] Healing Wave; [help,nodead] Healing Wave; [harm,nodead] Lightning Bolt; [@player] Healing Wave

keys.text: Healing Wave on a friend, Lightning Bolt on an enemy

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:alt,@player] Onda Curativa; [help,nodead] Onda Curativa; [harm,nodead] Raio; [@player] Onda Curativa

macros.title: Resurrect a mouseover or target
macros.desc: Resurrects the dead player under your cursor, or your dead target, once you're out of combat.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Ancestral Spirit
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead,nocombat][help,dead,nocombat] Ancestral Spirit
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Espírito Ancestral
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead,nocombat][help,dead,nocombat] Espírito Ancestral

macros.title: Interrupt with rank 1 Earth Shock
macros.desc: Dismounts, stops your cast and interrupts with rank 1 Earth Shock: your target, your mouseover with Shift or your last target with Ctrl.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Earth Shock
/dismount
/stopcasting
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Earth Shock(Rank 1)
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]

keys.text: Rank 1 Earth Shock on your target
Rank 1 Earth Shock on your mouseover
Shock your last target, then swap back

macros.needs: Ctrl swaps to your last target, shocks, then swaps back, so it needs a last target in range
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Terreno
/dismount
/stopcasting
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Choque Terreno(Grau 1)
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]

macros.title: Slow a runner with Frost Shock
macros.desc: Frost Shock slows your target by 50%; Shift slows your mouseover and Ctrl casts the cheap rank 1 on your target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Frost Shock
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Frost Shock; [mod:ctrl] Frost Shock(Rank 1); Frost Shock

keys.text: Frost Shock rank 1 on your target

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Gélido
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Choque Gélido; [mod:ctrl] Choque Gélido(Grau 1); Choque Gélido

macros.title: Grounding, Tremor, Earthbind and Stoneclaw on one key
macros.desc: Grounding Totem redirects one harmful spell aimed at a nearby party member, and Shift, Ctrl and Alt drop Tremor, Earthbind and Stoneclaw instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Grounding Totem
/cast [mod:shift] Tremor Totem; [mod:ctrl] Earthbind Totem; [mod:alt] Stoneclaw Totem; Grounding Totem
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Totem de Aterramento
/cast [mod:shift] Totem Sísmico; [mod:ctrl] Totem de Prisão Terrena; [mod:alt] Totem da Garra de Pedra; Totem de Aterramento

macros.title: Purge enemies and cure friends on one key
macros.desc: Purges an enemy, cures poison on a friend, and Shift cures disease on a friend, using your mouseover first and your target second.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead] Cure Disease; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] Cure Poison; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Purge

keys.text: Cure Poison on a friend or Purge on an enemy

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead] Curar Doença; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] Curar Veneno; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Expurgar

macros.title: Fast heal that drops the wolf
macros.desc: Leaves Ghost Wolf and casts Lesser Healing Wave on your mouseover or target, or on you when you hold Alt or have nobody picked.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lesser Healing Wave
/cancelform [form]
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Lesser Healing Wave

keys.text: Lesser Healing Wave on mouseover, target or yourself

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Onda Curativa Menor
/cancelform [form]
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Onda Curativa Menor

macros.title: Ghost Wolf on and off, or shock out of it
macros.desc: Press to switch Ghost Wolf on or off; hold Shift to leave the wolf and Frost Shock your target in one press.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Ghost Wolf
/cancelform [form,mod:shift]
/cast [mod:shift,harm,nodead] Frost Shock; [nomod,noform] Ghost Wolf
/cancelform [form,nomod]

keys.text: Ghost Wolf on, or off if you're already a wolf
Leave the wolf and Frost Shock your target

macros.needs: Ghost Wolf works outdoors only until you take Improved Ghost Wolf
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Lobo Fantasma
/cancelform [form,mod:shift]
/cast [mod:shift,harm,nodead] Choque Gélido; [nomod,noform] Lobo Fantasma
/cancelform [form,nomod]

macros.title: Trinkets and racial defense on one key
macros.desc: Uses your racial escape and both trinkets together when you're stunned or in trouble.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast War Stomp
/cast Stoneform
/cast Shatter Curse
/use 13
/use 14
macros.needs: Tauren (War Stomp), Dwarf (Stoneform) or Orc (Shatter Curse). The lines for other races just fail.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast Pisada de Guerra
/cast Forma de Pedra
/cast Estilhaçar Maldição
/use 13
/use 14

macros.title: Bolt or Chain Lightning on target or mouseover
macros.desc: Lightning Bolt on your target, Shift for your mouseover, and Ctrl or Alt for Chain Lightning on your target or mouseover.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lightning Bolt
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Lightning Bolt; [mod:ctrl] Chain Lightning; [mod:alt,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Chain Lightning; Lightning Bolt
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raio
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Raio; [mod:ctrl] Cadeia de Raios; [mod:alt,@mouseover,harm,nodead] Cadeia de Raios; Raio

macros.title: Flame Shock on target, mouseover or last target
macros.desc: Flame Shock your target, your mouseover with Shift or your last target with Ctrl, then swap back, to spread damage over time in a fight.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flame Shock
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Flame Shock
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]

keys.text: Flame Shock your last target, then swap back

macros.needs: Ctrl swaps to your last target and back, so it needs a last target in range
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Flamejante
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Choque Flamejante
/targetlasttarget [mod:ctrl]

macros.title: Cancel your cast for Grounding or Tremor
macros.desc: Stops the spell you're casting so Grounding Totem goes down the moment you see a Polymorph or Fear start. Shift drops Tremor Totem instead when a Warlock or Priest is about to fear.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Tremor Totem; Grounding Totem
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Tremor Totem; Grounding Totem

keys.text: Stop casting and drop Grounding Totem
Stop casting and drop Tremor Totem

macros.needs: Grounding Totem learned at 30. A press still cancels your cast while Grounding is on cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Totem Sísmico; Totem de Aterramento
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Totem Sísmico; Totem de Aterramento

macros.title: Rank 1 Flame Shock to keep stealth away
macros.desc: A cheap rank 1 Flame Shock on your mouseover or target. The burn keeps a Rogue or Druid in combat and breaks stealth as it ticks, so they can't hide until it wears off.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flame Shock
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Flame Shock(Rank 1)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Choque Flamejante
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Choque Flamejante(Grau 1)

macros.title: Lightning Bolt with Flame Shock on the same key
macros.desc: Lightning Bolt your target. Ctrl puts Flame Shock on your target and Shift puts it on your mouseover, so you can keep a burn on their healer while you cast.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lightning Bolt
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Flame Shock; Lightning Bolt
macros.needs: Flame Shock learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raio
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:ctrl] Choque Flamejante; Raio

macros.title: Lightning Mastery, trinkets and Lightning Bolt
macros.desc: Fires Lightning Mastery, both trinkets and your Orc or Troll racial, then starts Lightning Bolt, or Chain Lightning with Shift. For 15 sec Bolt casts 0.5 sec faster and Chain Lightning has no cooldown.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lightning Mastery
/cast Lightning Mastery
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Berserking
/cast Blood Fury
/cast [mod:shift] Chain Lightning; Lightning Bolt
macros.needs: Lightning Mastery talent; Chain Lightning (32) for Shift. Blood Fury is for Orcs and Berserking for Trolls; for other races those lines just fail. If Mastery is on cooldown the cast still starts.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Maestria em Raio
/cast Maestria em Raio
/use 13
/use 14
/cast Berserk
/cast Fúria Sangrenta
/cast [mod:shift] Cadeia de Raios; Raio

macros.title: Lightning Mastery into Chain Lightning
macros.desc: Lightning Mastery takes Chain Lightning's cooldown away for 15 sec, so this pops it and casts Chain Lightning on your mouseover or target. Keep pressing in a group fight.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Chain Lightning
/cast Lightning Mastery
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Chain Lightning
macros.needs: Lightning Mastery talent and Chain Lightning, learned at 32
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cadeia de Raios
/cast Maestria em Raio
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Cadeia de Raios

macros.title: Lightning Bolt with a cancel on Shift
macros.desc: Start Lightning Bolt to draw an interrupt and press with Shift to cancel it. A kick on Bolt locks your Nature spells, heals included, so make them waste it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lightning Bolt
/stopcasting [mod:shift]
/cast [nomod] Lightning Bolt
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Raio
/stopcasting [mod:shift]
/cast [nomod] Raio

macros.title: Stop casting and root melee with Earthbind
macros.desc: When melee reach you mid-cast, this cancels the cast and drops Earthbind Totem, which roots enemies near you for 5 sec with Earthbound. Shift Frost Shocks your mouseover or target instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Frost Shock; Earthbind Totem
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Frost Shock; Earthbind Totem

keys.text: Stop casting and drop Earthbind Totem
Stop casting and Frost Shock your mouseover or target

macros.needs: Earthbound talent for the root; without it Earthbind only slows
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Choque Gélido; Totem de Prisão Terrena
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Choque Gélido; Totem de Prisão Terrena

macros.title: Pull your totems to you, then Fire Nova
macros.desc: Shift casts Totemic Call, which moves your totems to where you stand. A plain press sets off Fire Nova at your Fire totem, so you can carry Magma Totem into a group and detonate it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Totemic Call; Fire Nova
/cast [mod:shift] Totemic Call; Fire Nova

keys.text: Fire Nova around your Fire totem
Totemic Call: your totems come to you

macros.needs: A Fire totem down for Fire Nova. Totemic Call has a 30 sec cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Chamado Totêmico; Nova de Fogo
/cast [mod:shift] Chamado Totêmico; Nova de Fogo

macros.title: Stormstrike, Earth Shock and Frost Shock in melee
macros.desc: Stormstrike to open, Shift for the Earth Shock that gets its 20% bonus and Ctrl for a Frost Shock slow; each one starts your swings.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Stormstrike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Earth Shock; [mod:ctrl] Frost Shock; Stormstrike
macros.needs: Stormstrike talent. It's a 16-point talent, so you can take it at 25 (Blizzard, 7 October).
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ataque da Tempestade
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Choque Terreno; [mod:ctrl] Choque Gélido; Ataque da Tempestade

macros.title: Ghost Wolf in, Stormstrike out
macros.desc: Shift turns you into a Ghost Wolf to close the gap. A plain press leaves the wolf, starts your swings and Stormstrikes in one go.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Ghost Wolf; Stormstrike
/cancelform [form,nomod]
/startattack [nomod]
/cast [mod:shift,noform] Ghost Wolf; [nomod] Stormstrike

keys.text: Leave Ghost Wolf, start swinging and Stormstrike

macros.needs: Stormstrike talent. Improved Ghost Wolf takes up to 3 sec off the wolf's cast and lets you use it indoors.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Lobo Fantasma; Ataque da Tempestade
/cancelform [form,nomod]
/startattack [nomod]
/cast [mod:shift,noform] Lobo Fantasma; [nomod] Ataque da Tempestade

macros.title: Stormstrike, with Ctrl to add your cooldowns
macros.desc: A plain press starts your swings and Stormstrikes. Hold Ctrl when you go for the kill to add Rage of the Farseer and both trinkets on the same press.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Stormstrike
/startattack
/cast [mod:ctrl] Rage of the Farseer
/use [mod:ctrl] 13
/use [mod:ctrl] 14
/cast Stormstrike

keys.text: Rage of the Farseer and both trinkets, then Stormstrike

macros.needs: Stormstrike and Rage of the Farseer talents
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ataque da Tempestade
/startattack
/cast [mod:ctrl] Fúria do Clarividente
/use [mod:ctrl] 13
/use [mod:ctrl] 14
/cast Ataque da Tempestade

macros.title: Stormstrike and Earth Shock on your mouseover
macros.desc: Stormstrike the enemy under your cursor, such as a healer beside your target, and Shift follows with Earth Shock on the same enemy while its 20% bonus is up. With no mouseover both hit your target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Earth Shock; Stormstrike
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Earth Shock; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Stormstrike
macros.needs: Stormstrike talent. You have to be in melee range of the enemy you're pointing at.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Choque Terreno; Ataque da Tempestade
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift] Choque Terreno; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Ataque da Tempestade

macros.title: Two-hander, or one-hander and shield
macros.desc: Equips your two-hander for Stormstrike and Windfury, or with Shift your one-hander and shield when melee or Hunters focus you. Put your own item names in place of the three placeholders.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/equip [nomod] Two-Hander Name
/equipslot [mod:shift] 16 One-Hand Name
/equipslot [mod:shift] 17 Shield Name
macros.needs: A two-hander, a one-hander and a shield in your bags. Imbues stay on the weapon you cast them on, so imbue both before the fight.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/equip [nomod] Nome da Arma de Duas Mãos
/equipslot [mod:shift] 16 Nome da Arma de Uma Mão
/equipslot [mod:shift] 17 Nome do Escudo

macros.title: Imbue for the weapon in your hand
macros.desc: Windfury Weapon on your two-hander, or Frostbrand Weapon when you have a shield on, so its slow procs help you peel while you defend.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [equipped:Shields] Frostbrand Weapon; Windfury Weapon
/cast [equipped:Shields] Frostbrand Weapon; Windfury Weapon
macros.needs: Windfury Weapon learned at 30. If the imbue asks for a weapon, click your main hand. Elemental Weapons makes both imbues hit harder.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [equipped:Escudos] Arma da Marca Gélida; Arma de Fúria dos Ventos
/cast [equipped:Escudos] Arma da Marca Gélida; Arma de Fúria dos Ventos

macros.title: Earthbind or Frost Shock and keep swinging
macros.desc: Drops Earthbind Totem at your feet so a kiting target can't walk out of melee, or Shift Frost Shocks your target. Both start your swings, and Earth's Grasp widens the totem's reach.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Frost Shock; Earthbind Totem
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Frost Shock; Earthbind Totem

keys.text: Frost Shock your target and start swinging

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Choque Gélido; Totem de Prisão Terrena
/startattack
/cast [mod:shift] Choque Gélido; Totem de Prisão Terrena

macros.title: Nature's Swiftness into an instant nuke
macros.desc: Nature's Swiftness makes the next spell instant: Lightning Bolt on your enemy, Chain Lightning with Shift or Healing Wave on you with Alt.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Nature's Swiftness
/cast Nature's Swiftness
/cast [mod:alt,@player] Healing Wave; [mod:shift,harm,nodead] Chain Lightning; [harm,nodead] Lightning Bolt

keys.text: Instant Lightning Bolt on your enemy target

macros.needs: Nature's Swiftness talent. If it's on cooldown the spell is a normal cast.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Rapidez da Natureza
/cast Rapidez da Natureza
/cast [mod:alt,@player] Onda Curativa; [mod:shift,harm,nodead] Cadeia de Raios; [harm,nodead] Raio

macros.title: Riptide, or Chain Heal on the same friend
macros.desc: Riptide on your mouseover, target or you, and Shift casts Chain Heal on the same friend, which lands 25% stronger on a Riptide target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Riptide
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead] Chain Heal; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Riptide

keys.text: Riptide on mouseover, target or yourself
Chain Heal on mouseover or target

macros.needs: Riptide talent and Chain Heal learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Contracorrente
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead] Cura Encadeada; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Contracorrente

macros.title: Instant Riptide that drops the wolf and your cast
macros.desc: Leaves Ghost Wolf, cancels the heal you're casting and lands Riptide on your mouseover, friendly target or you. Shift and Ctrl send it to your first and second party members.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Riptide
/cancelform [form]
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Riptide

keys.text: Riptide on mouseover, friendly target or you

macros.needs: Riptide talent. It only heals over time now, on a 12 sec cooldown, and a press still cancels your cast while it’s cooling down.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Contracorrente
/cancelform [form]
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Contracorrente

macros.title: Nature's Swiftness Healing Wave on a party member
macros.desc: Stops your cast, then Nature's Swiftness makes Healing Wave instant on your mouseover, friendly target or you. Shift and Ctrl send it to party members 1 and 2, Alt to yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Nature's Swiftness
/stopcasting
/cast Nature's Swiftness
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Healing Wave

keys.text: Instant Healing Wave on mouseover, friendly target or you
Instant Healing Wave on party member 1
Instant Healing Wave on party member 2

macros.needs: Nature's Swiftness talent. If it's on cooldown you start a normal Healing Wave, and pressing again restarts it.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Rapidez da Natureza
/stopcasting
/cast Rapidez da Natureza
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Onda Curativa

macros.title: Lesser Healing Wave on your party from the keyboard
macros.desc: Fast heal on your mouseover, friendly target or you, or on party members 1, 2 and 3 with Shift, Ctrl and Alt, so you can keep your eyes on the fight instead of the frames.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Lesser Healing Wave
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][mod:alt,@party3][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Lesser Healing Wave

keys.text: Lesser Healing Wave on mouseover, friendly target or you
Lesser Healing Wave on party member 1
Lesser Healing Wave on party member 2
Lesser Healing Wave on party member 3

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Onda Curativa Menor
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][mod:alt,@party3][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Onda Curativa Menor

macros.title: Heal whoever your enemy target is hitting
macros.desc: Keep the enemy selected and heal the friend they're attacking: Lesser Healing Wave, Shift for Healing Wave, Ctrl for Chain Heal or Alt for Riptide.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@targettarget,help,nodead] Healing Wave; [mod:ctrl,@targettarget,help,nodead] Chain Heal; [mod:alt,@targettarget,help,nodead] Riptide; [@targettarget,help,nodead] Lesser Healing Wave

keys.text: Lesser Healing Wave on your enemy's target
Healing Wave on your enemy's target
Chain Heal on your enemy's target

macros.needs: An enemy target that is attacking a friend. Chain Heal is learned at 40 and Riptide is a talent.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [mod:shift,@targettarget,help,nodead] Onda Curativa; [mod:ctrl,@targettarget,help,nodead] Cura Encadeada; [mod:alt,@targettarget,help,nodead] Contracorrente; [@targettarget,help,nodead] Onda Curativa Menor

macros.title: Shock or Purge the enemy your friend is fighting
macros.desc: Keep a friend targeted for healing and still interrupt: rank 1 Earth Shock on your mouseover, or on the enemy your friendly target is attacking. Shift purges the same enemy.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift,@targettarget,harm,nodead][mod:shift,harm,nodead] Purge; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Earth Shock(Rank 1)

keys.text: Rank 1 Earth Shock on mouseover or your friend's target
Purge on mouseover or your friend's target

macros.needs: Purge learned at 12. Cancels your current cast.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift,@targettarget,harm,nodead][mod:shift,harm,nodead] Expurgar; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Choque Terreno(Grau 1)

macros.title: Mana Tide Totem and a mana potion together
macros.desc: Drops Mana Tide Totem and drinks a mana potion on the same press when a long fight drains you. With 5 health the totem dies to any area damage, so drop it once you are clear of it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mana Tide Totem
/cast Mana Tide Totem
/use Major Mana Potion
macros.needs: Mana Tide Totem talent and its Water Totem tool. Put the potion you carry in place of Major Mana Potion.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Totem de Vagalhão de Mana
/cast Totem de Vagalhão de Mana
/use Poção Elevada de Mana
